name: telugu-states-instagram-shorts
description: Reusable 9:16 Remotion motion-graphics template for Telugu States follower-house videos.

scripts.render: node scripts/validate-data.mjs video-data.json --require-footage && remotion render src/index.jsx CommunityShort out/community-short.mp4 --props=video-data.json
scripts.still: node scripts/validate-data.mjs video-data.json --require-footage && remotion still src/index.jsx CommunityShort out/preview.png --frame=450 --props=video-data.json
